THE LAST GESTURE — 60s Zombie Horror/Dark-Comedy Prompt (16:9)

Context: Photorealistic zombie horror drama with an abrupt deadpan dark-comedy payoff. Shot on ARRI Alexa 35 with spherical prime lenses. A compact modern apartment in Beijing at night, recently lived-in and freshly disturbed — displaced furniture, one overturned chair, scattered small objects, a messy table, curtains pulled out of place; the architecture stays intact and contemporary. Mood: an ordinary home turned hostile, where one familiar gesture briefly reopens something the room has already lost. Visual grade: low-key cinematic underexposure, cold 5600K window spill against a single 3000K practical lamp, natural skin texture, natural motion blur, restrained depth of field, subtle fine 35mm film grain. The grade stays fixed across every shot.

The apartment exists in two timeline states. PRESENT state: night, cold blue-grey spill from the frame-left window, one dim warm lamp making small amber pockets, furniture disturbed. MEMORY state: the identical apartment before the outbreak — furniture restored, surfaces tidy, soft even 3000–3500K domestic practical light wrapping the faces, no horror shadows, skin alive and healthy. Room geometry, furniture placement and camera angle stay identical between the two states; only lighting, tidiness and mood change.

Camera language: PRESENT state is nervous handheld throughout — visible operator shake, reactive reframing, small lateral corrections, short push-pulls, slight roll during physical struggle, unstable breathing drift. MEMORY state is the deliberate opposite — smooth, quiet, stable, almost no shake. Every shot below declares which mode it uses.

Location this video: the living room, with a small dining area, kitchenette and hallway mouth carrying background depth.

Characters

Chen Hao (male lead) — Chinese, late 20s, lean-athletic build, angular face with a strong jaw, dark brown eyes, short black hair with natural volume and a slight fringe, warm light-tan skin, naturally attractive in an unpolished, boy-next-door way. Wardrobe: oversized washed charcoal t-shirt, lightweight dark grey open overshirt, relaxed dark jogger pants, dark low-top canvas sneakers. Chen Hao is the only man in the video.

Su Yi (female lead) — Chinese, mid-20s, strikingly beautiful, tall and slim with a model's proportions and posture, long dark slightly wavy hair with soft wispy bangs, thin round metal-frame eyeglasses, warm brown eyes, fair porcelain skin, delicate refined features — the epitome of elegant beauty. Wardrobe (MEMORY state): cream cropped cardigan over a white inner top, charcoal-grey pleated mini skirt, white socks, white shoes. Su Yi exists only inside the MEMORY state — clean, healthy, unharmed.

Continuity lock — glasses: Su Yi wears the same thin round metal-frame eyeglasses in every single shot of the video, PRESENT and MEMORY alike, with zero exceptions. She never appears without them. In MEMORY state the glasses are clean and sit straight; in PRESENT/zombie state the same glasses are dirty and crooked but still on her face. Do not remove or omit the glasses in any shot, including Shots 5 and 6.

Su Yi Zombie — the same face, same glasses (dirty, crooked, but present), same hairstyle base and same body proportions as Su Yi. Wardrobe override: the identical cream cardigan, white inner top and charcoal-grey pleated skirt now torn and distressed, skin pale and unhealthy, dark hollow eye sockets, glasses dirty and crooked, hair messy and matted, blood smears and grime across face, hands and clothing.

Su Yi and Su Yi Zombie are the same woman at two points in time — the same person before and after.

Chen Hao Zombie (late reveal, Shot 13 only) — same face, same short black hair, same build as Chen Hao. Wardrobe unchanged but now torn at the shoulder/collar where he was bitten, skin gone pale and grey, eyes clouded and hollow, a fresh bloody bite wound visible at the base of his neck through the torn overshirt, posture slack and stiff like Su Yi Zombie's.

Spatial anchor: Chen Hao starts in midground-left, backing diagonally toward camera past the overturned chair. Su Yi Zombie comes in from midground-right, out of the direction of the dining area. The kitchenette and the hallway mouth stay visible in deep background behind both. All blocking stays on one side of the room — the camera never crosses to the opposite wall.

Not a destroyed post-apocalyptic ruin — the apartment is recently messy, still intact and modern. Not an outdoor scene. Su Yi and Su Yi Zombie are never in frame at the same time.

Generation note: the 12 shots below are split into two 30-second halves so each can be generated as its own clip and stitched together. Each shot lists two timestamps — "clip time" (seconds within that 30s generation) and "full video" (seconds in the final 60s edit). PART 1 ends on the tender embrace (the emotional high point); PART 2 opens with the kiss and turns into the horror payoff.

PART 1 — "Before" (0:00–0:30) — PRESENT struggle → dissolve into MEMORY tenderness
Shot 1 — 0:00–0:05 (clip time) / 0:00–0:05 (full video)

Camera: PRESENT mode. Handheld medium-wide from inside the living room, backing away with Chen Hao while drifting slightly sideways, 32mm. Shake reacts to Su Yi Zombie's unpredictable movement. Foreground: blurred edge of the overturned chair at frame-left. Midground: Chen Hao backing diagonally toward camera as Su Yi Zombie surges in from the right. Background: kitchenette and hallway mouth in low cold light. Act: Su Yi Zombie lunges at Chen Hao with uncontrolled hungry aggression — mouth open, shoulders jerking, rapid uneven steps, hands clawing forward, matted hair swinging across the crooked glasses. Chen Hao backs away fast, eyes wide, forearms raised defensively, never turning his back. Constrain: Su Yi Zombie reads as frightening from the very first frame — feral, unstable, no lingering human softness yet. Audio: uneven aggressive footsteps, furniture scraping the floor, wet snarling breath, Chen Hao's ragged breathing, clothing friction.

Shot 2 — 0:05–0:10 (clip time) / 0:05–0:10 (full video)

Camera: PRESENT mode. Handheld medium two-shot from slightly below eye level, anchored between Chen Hao at left-midground and Su Yi Zombie at right-midground, 40mm. Small backward and lateral corrections follow the struggle; slight roll when Su Yi Zombie jerks sideways. Act: Su Yi Zombie lunges again. Chen Hao catches her and grips both shoulders firmly, arms fully extended to hold the snapping mouth away from his neck. Su Yi Zombie thrashes violently — torso twisting, mouth snapping forward, head thrown side to side. Chen Hao's jaw clenches, brows pull together, breathing fast, hands tightening — visibly straining. Constrain: Chen Hao's hands stay clamped on both shoulders with arms extended for the whole shot — the mouth never reaches his neck here. Real time speed. Audio: palms slapping onto shoulders, shoe friction on the floor, strained exhales, snarling, fabric stretching.

Shot 3 — 0:10–0:14 (clip time) / 0:10–0:14 (full video)

Camera: PRESENT mode. Handheld chest-up two-shot, slow unstable micro push-in, 50mm. Shake gradually reduces but never fully disappears. Act: Su Yi Zombie's thrashing tapers into small spasms, then heavy breathing, then near stillness; the mouth slowly closes and the vacant eyes lock directly onto Chen Hao. Chen Hao stays tense and confused, hands still clamped down, not trusting the sudden calm. Constrain: the momentum drains progressively and visibly — the stillness stays uncanny and vacant, never a warm human expression. Audio: the chaotic sound suddenly drops away; heavy breathing from both, faint clothing settle, low cold room tone.

Shot 4 — 0:14–0:19 (clip time) / 0:14–0:19 (full video)

Camera: PRESENT mode dissolving into MEMORY mode. Tight handheld two-shot, very slow shaky push-in toward the space between Chen Hao's chest and Su Yi Zombie's rising hand, 50mm. Act: Su Yi Zombie slowly raises one hand toward Chen Hao's neck; he stiffens instantly, eyes tracking the hand. Instead of biting, she grips the edge of the dark grey overshirt collar and with strangely precise small finger movements straightens it and smooths the fabric near his upper chest. Chen Hao's expression shifts from fear into stunned recognition. On the last beat the image cross-dissolves into the MEMORY state while the hand keeps moving. Constrain: the dissolve preserves the exact camera angle, body position, hand placement, eyeline and spacing — only the woman, the lighting and the room's tidiness change, and the handheld shake dissolves into perfectly stable movement across the same beat. Audio: fabric brushing under fingertips, two sets of breathing, the cold room tone slowly warming.

Contexto: drama de horror zombi fotorrealista con un remate abrupto de comedia negra impasible. Rodado con ARRI Alexa 35 y lentes prime esféricas. Un apartamento moderno y compacto en Pekín de noche, recientemente habitado y recién alterado: muebles desplazados, una silla volcada, pequeños objetos esparcidos, una mesa desordenada, cortinas fuera de lugar; la arquitectura se mantiene intacta y contemporánea. Ambiente: un hogar ordinario vuelto hostil, donde un gesto familiar reabre por un instante algo que la habitación ya había perdido. Grading visual: subexposición cinematográfica de bajo nivel, derrame frío de ventana a 5600K contra una sola lámpara práctica a 3000K, textura natural de piel, motion blur natural, profundidad de campo contenida, grano fino sutil de película 35 mm. El grading se mantiene fijo en cada plano.

El apartamento existe en dos estados temporales. Estado PRESENTE: noche, derrame frío azul grisáceo desde la ventana del lado izquierdo del encuadre, una lámpara cálida tenue creando pequeños bolsillos ámbar, muebles alterados. Estado MEMORIA: el mismo apartamento antes del brote — muebles restaurados, superficies ordenadas, luz práctica doméstica suave y uniforme de 3000–3500K envolviendo los rostros, sin sombras de horror, piel viva y sana. La geometría de la habitación, la disposición de los muebles y el ángulo de cámara se mantienen idénticos entre ambos estados; solo cambian la iluminación, el orden y el estado de ánimo.

Lenguaje de cámara: el estado PRESENTE es nervioso y handheld en todo momento — temblor visible del operador, reencuadres reactivos, pequeñas correcciones laterales, breves empujes y retrocesos, leve roll durante la lucha física, deriva inestable por la respiración. El estado MEMORIA es el opuesto deliberado — suave, silencioso, estable, casi sin temblor. Cada plano abajo indica qué modo usa.

Ubicación de este video: la sala de estar, con un pequeño comedor, kitchenette y la boca del pasillo aportando profundidad de fondo.

Personajes

Chen Hao (protagonista masculino) — chino, finales de los 20, complexión delgada y atlética, rostro anguloso con mandíbula marcada, ojos marrón oscuro, cabello negro corto con volumen natural y un ligero flequillo, piel morena clara cálida, atractivo de forma natural, sin pulir, con aire de chico de al lado. Vestuario: camiseta oversized lavada color carbón, sobrecamisa ligera gris oscuro abierta, pantalón jogger oscuro relajado, zapatillas de lona oscuras de caña baja. Chen Hao es el único hombre en el video.

Su Yi (protagonista femenina) — china, mediados de los 20, impactantemente hermosa, alta y esbelta con proporciones y postura de modelo, cabello largo oscuro ligeramente ondulado con suaves mechones desfilados, gafas finas redondas de montura metálica, ojos marrón cálido, piel porcelana clara, rasgos delicados y refinados — la personificación de la belleza elegante. Vestuario (estado MEMORIA): cárdigan corto color crema sobre una prenda interior blanca, minifalda plisada gris carbón, calcetines blancos, zapatos blancos. Su Yi existe solo dentro del estado MEMORIA — limpia, sana, ilesa.

Bloqueo de continuidad — gafas: Su Yi lleva las mismas gafas finas redondas de montura metálica en cada plano del video, tanto en PRESENTE como en MEMORIA, sin ninguna excepción. Nunca aparece sin ellas. En el estado MEMORIA las gafas están limpias y rectas; en el estado PRESENTE/zombi las mismas gafas están sucias y torcidas, pero siguen en su rostro. No quitar ni omitir las gafas en ningún plano, incluidos los Planos 5 y 6.

Su Yi Zombi — el mismo rostro, las mismas gafas (sucias, torcidas, pero presentes), la misma base de peinado y las mismas proporciones corporales que Su Yi. Cambio de vestuario: el mismo cárdigan crema, la prenda interior blanca y la falda plisada gris carbón ahora rasgados y deteriorados, piel pálida y enfermiza, cuencas oculares oscuras y hundidas, gafas sucias y torcidas, cabello desordenado y apelmazado, manchas de sangre y suciedad en el rostro, manos y ropa.

Su Yi y Su Yi Zombi son la misma mujer en dos momentos del tiempo — la misma persona antes y después.

Chen Hao Zombi (revelación tardía, solo Plano 13) — mismo rostro, mismo cabello negro corto, misma complexión que Chen Hao. Vestuario sin cambios pero ahora rasgado en el hombro/cuello donde fue mordido, piel pálida y gris, ojos velados y vacíos, una herida fresca y sangrante de mordida visible en la base del cuello a través de la sobrecamisa rasgada, postura flácida y rígida como la de Su Yi Zombi.

Ancla espacial: Chen Hao comienza en el plano medio-izquierdo, retrocediendo en diagonal hacia cámara pasando junto a la silla volcada. Su Yi Zombi entra desde el plano medio-derecho, desde la dirección del comedor. La kitchenette y la boca del pasillo permanecen visibles en el fondo profundo detrás de ambos. Toda la acción se mantiene en un solo lado de la habitación — la cámara nunca cruza a la pared opuesta.

No es una ruina postapocalíptica destruida — el apartamento está recientemente desordenado, pero sigue intacto y moderno. No es una escena exterior. Su Yi y Su Yi Zombi nunca aparecen en cuadro al mismo tiempo.

Cada plano incluye dos marcas de tiempo — "clip time" (segundos dentro de esa generación de 30 s) y "full video" (segundos en el montaje final de 60 s). LA DERNIÈRE GESTE — Prompt horreur zombie / dark-comedy de 60 s (16:9)

Contexte : drame d’horreur zombie photoréaliste avec un payoff de dark-comedy abrupt et impassible. Tourné sur ARRI Alexa 35 avec des objectifs prime sphériques. Un appartement moderne compact à Pékin, la nuit, récemment habité et fraîchement perturbé — meubles déplacés, une chaise renversée, petits objets éparpillés, table en désordre, rideaux tirés de travers ; l’architecture reste intacte et contemporaine. Ambiance : un foyer ordinaire devenu hostile, où un geste familier rouvre brièvement quelque chose que la pièce a déjà perdu. Étalonnage visuel : sous-exposition cinématographique low-key, fuite froide de fenêtre à 5600K contre une seule lampe pratique à 3000K, texture de peau naturelle, motion blur naturel, profondeur de champ contenue, grain fin subtil de pellicule 35 mm. L’étalonnage reste fixe sur chaque plan.

L’appartement existe en deux états temporels. État PRESENT : nuit, fuite bleu-gris froide depuis la fenêtre côté cadre gauche, une lampe chaude faible créant de petites poches ambrées, mobilier perturbé. État MEMORY : le même appartement avant l’épidémie — mobilier remis en place, surfaces rangées, lumière pratique domestique douce et uniforme à 3000–3500K enveloppant les visages, aucune ombre d’horreur, peau vivante et saine. La géométrie de la pièce, l’emplacement du mobilier et l’angle de caméra restent identiques entre les deux états ; seuls changent l’éclairage, l’ordre et l’ambiance.

Langage caméra : l’état PRESENT est nerveux et handheld du début à la fin — tremblement visible de l’opérateur, recadrages réactifs, petites corrections latérales, courts push-pulls, léger roulis pendant la lutte physique, dérive respiratoire instable. L’état MEMORY est l’opposé assumé — fluide, silencieux, stable, presque sans tremblement. Chaque plan ci-dessous précise le mode utilisé.

Lieu de cette vidéo : le salon, avec un petit coin repas, une kitchenette et l’ouverture du couloir apportant de la profondeur en arrière-plan.

Personnages

Chen Hao (rôle masculin principal) — Chinois, fin vingtaine, silhouette mince et athlétique, visage anguleux avec une mâchoire marquée, yeux brun foncé, cheveux noirs courts avec du volume naturel et une légère frange, peau beige clair chaude, naturellement séduisant d’une manière brute et de voisin d’à côté. Tenue : t-shirt charbon délavé oversize, surchemise gris foncé légère ouverte, pantalon de jogging sombre décontracté, baskets basses en toile foncées. Chen Hao est le seul homme de la vidéo.

Su Yi (rôle féminin principal) — Chinoise, milieu vingtaine, d’une beauté saisissante, grande et mince avec des proportions et une posture de mannequin, longs cheveux foncés légèrement ondulés avec une frange légère et vaporeuse, fines lunettes rondes à monture métallique, yeux brun chaud, peau porcelaine claire, traits délicats et raffinés — l’incarnation de l’élégance. Tenue (état MEMORY) : cardigan court crème sur un haut blanc, mini-jupe plissée gris charbon, chaussettes blanches, chaussures blanches. Su Yi n’existe que dans l’état MEMORY — propre, saine, indemne.

Verrou de continuité — lunettes : Su Yi porte les mêmes fines lunettes rondes à monture métallique dans chaque plan de la vidéo, en PRESENT comme en MEMORY, sans aucune exception. Elle n’apparaît jamais sans elles. Dans l’état MEMORY, les lunettes sont propres et bien droites ; dans l’état PRESENT/zombie, les mêmes lunettes sont sales et de travers mais toujours sur son visage. Ne retirez ni n’omettez les lunettes dans aucun plan, y compris les plans 5 et 6.

Su Yi Zombie — le même visage, les mêmes lunettes (sales, de travers, mais présentes), la même base de coiffure et les mêmes proportions corporelles que Su Yi. Remplacement de tenue : le même cardigan crème, le même haut blanc et la même jupe plissée gris charbon sont désormais déchirés et abîmés, la peau est pâle et malsaine, les orbites sont sombres et creuses, les lunettes sont sales et de travers, les cheveux sont en désordre et collés, des traces de sang et de crasse couvrent le visage, les mains et les vêtements.

Su Yi et Su Yi Zombie sont la même femme à deux moments différents — la même personne avant et après.

Chen Hao Zombie (révélation tardive, plan 13 uniquement) — même visage, mêmes cheveux noirs courts, même carrure que Chen Hao. Tenue inchangée mais désormais déchirée à l’épaule/au col là où il a été mordu, peau devenue pâle et grise, yeux voilés et creux, une plaie de morsure fraîche et sanglante visible à la base du cou à travers la surchemise déchirée, posture relâchée et raide comme celle de Su Yi Zombie.

Ancrage spatial : Chen Hao commence au milieu-gauche, reculant en diagonale vers la caméra en passant devant la chaise renversée. Su Yi Zombie entre depuis le milieu-droit, depuis la direction du coin repas. La kitchenette et l’ouverture du couloir restent visibles en profondeur derrière eux. Toute la mise en scène reste d’un seul côté de la pièce — la caméra ne franchit jamais vers le mur opposé.

Pas une ruine post-apocalyptique détruite — l’appartement est simplement en désordre récent, toujours intact et moderne. Pas une scène extérieure. Su Yi et Su Yi Zombie ne sont jamais dans le cadre en même temps.

THE LAST GESTURE — 60秒 ゾンビホラー／ダークコメディ prompt（16:9）

Context: フォトリアルなゾンビホラードラマに、唐突で無表情なダークコメディのオチが付く構成。ARRI Alexa 35で、球面プライムレンズを使用して撮影。舞台は北京の夜のコンパクトな現代アパート。最近まで人が住んでいた気配があり、今しがた荒らされたばかりの状態——家具の位置がずれ、椅子が1脚倒れ、小物が散乱し、テーブルは散らかり、カーテンも乱れている。建築自体は無傷で現代的なまま。ムード: ありふれた家が敵意を帯び、見慣れたひとつの仕草が、その部屋がすでに失ったものを一瞬だけ呼び戻す。ビジュアルグレード: ローキーなシネマティック・アンダーエクスポージャー、5600Kの冷たい窓光が、3000Kの実用灯1灯に対して差し込む。自然な肌の質感、自然なモーションブラー、抑えた被写界深度、繊細な35mmフィルムグレイン。グレードは全ショットで固定。

このアパートは2つのタイムライン状態で存在する。PRESENT state: 夜、フレーム左の窓から冷たい青灰色の光が差し込み、弱い暖色のランプが小さな琥珀色の溜まりを作り、家具は乱れている。MEMORY state: 感染発生前の同じアパート——家具は元に戻り、表面は整頓され、柔らかく均一な3000–3500Kの家庭用実用光が顔を包み、ホラーの影はなく、肌は生き生きとして健康的。部屋の形状、家具配置、カメラアングルは2つの状態で完全に一致し、変わるのは照明、整頓具合、ムードだけ。

Camera language: PRESENT state は終始神経質な handheld —— 目に見えるオペレーターの揺れ、反応的なリフレーミング、小さな横方向の補正、短い押し引き、身体的なもみ合い中のわずかなロール、不安定な呼吸に引かれる漂い。MEMORY state はその正反対——滑らかで静か、安定しており、揺れはほぼない。以下の各ショットで、どちらのモードかを明記する。

Location this video: リビングルーム。奥行きの背景として、小さなダイニングエリア、キッチン、廊下の入口が見える。

Characters

Chen Hao（男性主人公）— 中国人、20代後半、細身でアスレチックな体格、強い顎を持つ角張った顔、濃い茶色の目、自然なボリュームと少しの前髪がある短い黒髪、温かみのある薄い小麦色の肌。飾り気のない“隣の家の男の子”のような自然な魅力。Wardrobe: オーバーサイズの洗いざらしのチャコールTシャツ、軽いダークグレーのオープンシャツ、ゆったりしたダーク系ジョガーパンツ、ダークカラーのローカットキャンバススニーカー。Chen Hao は動画内で唯一の男性。

Su Yi（女性主人公）— 中国人、20代半ば、目を引く美しさ。モデルのようなプロポーションと姿勢を持つ高身長で細身の体型、長くてややウェーブしたダークヘアに柔らかな薄い前髪、細い丸型メタルフレームの眼鏡、温かみのある茶色い目、白く陶器のような肌、繊細で洗練された顔立ち——エレガントな美の体現。Wardrobe（MEMORY state）: クリーム色のクロップドカーディガンの下に白いインナー、チャコールグレーのプリーツミニスカート、白い靴下、白い靴。Su Yi は MEMORY state の中にのみ存在し、清潔で健康で、傷ついていない。

Continuity lock — glasses: Su Yi は動画の全ショットで、PRESENT と MEMORY の両方において、同じ細い丸型メタルフレームの眼鏡を必ず着用する。例外は一切ない。眼鏡なしで登場してはならない。MEMORY state では眼鏡は清潔でまっすぐ、PRESENT/zombie state では同じ眼鏡が汚れて傾いているが、それでも顔に掛かっている。Shot 5 と 6 を含め、どのショットでも眼鏡を外したり省略したりしないこと。

Su Yi Zombie — Su Yi と同じ顔、同じ眼鏡（汚れて傾いているが装着されている）、同じ髪型のベース、同じ体型。Wardrobe override: 同じクリーム色カーディガン、白いインナー、チャコールグレーのプリーツスカートが今は破れ、傷み、肌は青白く不健康、目のくぼみは暗く空洞、眼鏡は汚れて傾き、髪は乱れて絡まり、顔・手・衣服に血の汚れと grime が付着している。

Su Yi と Su Yi Zombie は、時間の異なる2点にいる同じ女性——前後で同一人物。

Chen Hao Zombie（遅い明かし、Shot 13 のみ）— Chen Hao と同じ顔、同じ短い黒髪、同じ体格。Wardrobe は変わらないが、噛まれた肩／襟元が破れ、肌は青白く灰色がかり、目は濁って空洞、破れたオープンシャツ越しに首の付け根に新しい血の噛み傷が見え、姿勢は Su Yi Zombie のように力なく硬直している。

Spatial anchor: Chen Hao は midground-left から始まり、倒れた椅子の脇を通ってカメラに向かって斜め後退する。Su Yi Zombie は midground-right、ダイニングエリアの方向から入ってくる。キッチンと廊下の入口は、両者の背後の深い背景に見え続ける。ブロッキングは常に部屋の片側に留まり、カメラは反対側の壁へは回り込まない。

破壊された終末後の廃墟ではない——アパートは最近散らかっただけで、まだ無傷で現代的。屋外シーンではない。Su Yi と Su Yi Zombie が同じフレームに同時に入ることはない。

Generation note: 以下の12ショットは2つの30秒パートに分割されており、それぞれ独立したクリップとして生成してからつなぎ合わせる。各ショットには2つのタイムスタンプ——"clip time"（その30秒生成内の秒数）と "full video"（完成版60秒編集内の秒数）——が記載される。PART 1 は優しい抱擁で終わり（感情のピーク）、PART 2 はキスで始まり、ホラーのオチへ転じる。

PART 1 — "Before" (0:00–0:30) — PRESENT のもみ合い → MEMORY の優しさへ溶ける

ko.content:
THE LAST GESTURE — 60초 좀비 호러/다크 코미디 프롬프트 (16:9)

Context: 포토리얼한 좀비 호러 드라마에, 갑작스럽고 무덤덤한 다크 코미디의 반전이 더해진 구성. ARRI Alexa 35와 구면 프라임 렌즈로 촬영. 밤의 베이징에 있는 컴팩트한 현대식 아파트, 최근까지 사람이 살았고 방금 어지럽혀진 상태 — 밀려난 가구, 뒤집힌 의자 하나, 흩어진 작은 물건들, 어수선한 테이블, 제자리를 벗어난 커튼; 건축 구조는 그대로 온전하고 현대적이다. 분위기: 익숙한 집이 적대적으로 변한 공간, 한 번의 익숙한 제스처가 이미 잃어버린 무언가를 잠시 다시 열어젖히는 순간. 비주얼 그레이드: 로우키 시네마틱 언더노출, 차가운 5600K 창빛이 하나의 3000K 실내 조명과 대비되고, 자연스러운 피부 질감, 자연스러운 모션 블러, 절제된 심도, 미세한 35mm 필름 그레인. 이 그레이드는 모든 샷에서 고정된다.

아파트는 두 개의 타임라인 상태로 존재한다. PRESENT 상태: 밤, 프레임 왼쪽 창문에서 들어오는 차갑고 푸른 회색빛, 희미한 따뜻한 램프가 작은 호박색 영역을 만들고, 가구는 흐트러져 있다. MEMORY 상태: 발병 이전의 동일한 아파트 — 가구는 제자리에 돌아와 있고, 표면은 정돈되어 있으며, 부드럽고 고른 3000–3500K의 가정용 실내 조명이 얼굴을 감싸고, 호러 그림자는 없고, 피부는 살아 있고 건강하다. 방의 구조, 가구 배치, 카메라 앵글은 두 상태에서 동일하게 유지되며, 조명, 정돈 상태, 분위기만 달라진다.

카메라 언어: PRESENT 상태는 전 구간 내내 불안한 핸드헬드 — 보이는 오퍼레이터 흔들림, 반응적인 리프레이밍, 작은 좌우 보정, 짧은 푸시-풀, 물리적 몸싸움 중의 약한 롤, 불안정한 호흡에 따른 드리프트. MEMORY 상태는 그 정반대 — 부드럽고 조용하며 안정적이고, 흔들림이 거의 없다. 아래의 모든 샷은 어떤 모드를 사용하는지 명시한다.

이 영상의 장소: 거실. 작은 식사 공간, 키친넷, 그리고 깊이감을 주는 복도 입구가 함께 보인다.

Characters

Chen Hao (male lead) — 중국인, 20대 후반, 마른 운동형 체격, 강한 턱선이 돋보이는 각진 얼굴, 짙은 갈색 눈, 자연스러운 볼륨과 약간의 앞머리가 있는 짧은 검은 머리, 따뜻한 연한 황갈색 피부, 꾸미지 않은 이웃집 남자 같은 자연스러운 매력. 의상: 워싱된 차콜색 오버사이즈 티셔츠, 가벼운 다크 그레이 오픈 셔츠, 편안한 다크 조거 팬츠, 다크 로우탑 캔버스 스니커즈. Chen Hao는 영상에서 유일한 남자다.

Su Yi (female lead) — 중국인, 20대 중반, 눈부시게 아름답고, 모델 같은 비율과 자세를 지닌 키 크고 슬림한 체형, 길고 어두운 약간 웨이브진 머리와 부드러운 잔머리 앞머리, 얇은 원형 메탈 프레임 안경, 따뜻한 갈색 눈, 창백한 도자기 같은 피부, 섬세하고 세련된 이목구비 — 우아한 아름다움의 전형. 의상 (MEMORY 상태): 화이트 이너 탑 위에 크림색 크롭 가디건, 차콜 그레이 플리츠 미니 스커트, 흰 양말, 흰 신발. Su Yi는 MEMORY 상태 안에서만 존재한다 — 깨끗하고, 건강하며, 다치지 않은 상태.

Continuity lock — glasses: Su Yi는 영상의 모든 샷에서, PRESENT와 MEMORY를 막론하고, 동일한 얇은 원형 메탈 프레임 안경을 반드시 착용한다. 예외는 단 하나도 없다. 그녀는 안경 없이 등장하지 않는다. MEMORY 상태에서는 안경이 깨끗하고 반듯하게 착용되어 있으며, PRESENT/zombie 상태에서는 같은 안경이 더럽고 삐뚤어져 있지만 여전히 얼굴에 걸쳐 있다. Shots 5와 6을 포함해 어떤 샷에서도 안경을 제거하거나 생략하지 말 것.

Su Yi Zombie — Su Yi와 같은 얼굴, 같은 안경(더럽고 삐뚤어졌지만 착용 중), 같은 기본 헤어스타일과 같은 체형. 의상 오버라이드: 동일한 크림 가디건, 화이트 이너 탑, 차콜 그레이 플리츠 스커트가 이제 찢기고 해진 상태, 피부는 창백하고 건강하지 않으며, 눈은 어둡고 텅 빈 소켓처럼 보이고, 안경은 더럽고 삐뚤어져 있으며, 머리는 흐트러지고 엉켜 있고, 얼굴과 손, 옷에는 피 자국과 때가 묻어 있다.

Su Yi와 Su Yi Zombie는 같은 여성이 시간의 두 지점에 존재하는 것 — 전과 후의 동일 인물이다.

Chen Hao Zombie (late reveal, Shot 13 only) — Chen Hao와 같은 얼굴, 같은 짧은 검은 머리, 같은 체격. 의상은 그대로지만 물린 어깨/칼라 부분이 찢겨 있고, 피부는 창백하고 회색빛으로 변했으며, 눈은 흐리고 텅 비어 있고, 찢어진 오픈 셔츠 사이로 목 아래쪽에 تازه한 피 묻은 물린 상처가 보이며, 자세는 Su Yi Zombie처럼 축 늘어지고 뻣뻣하다.

Spatial anchor: Chen Hao는 미드그라운드 왼쪽에서 시작해, 뒤집힌 의자를 지나 카메라 쪽으로 대각선 후퇴한다. Su Yi Zombie는 미드그라운드 오른쪽, 식사 공간 방향에서 들어온다. 키친넷과 복도 입구는 둘 다 뒤쪽 깊은 배경에서 계속 보인다. 모든 블로킹은 방의 한쪽에서만 이뤄지며 — 카메라는 절대 반대편 벽으로 넘어가지 않는다.

무너진 포스트아포칼립스 폐허가 아니다 — 아파트는 최근에 어수선해졌을 뿐, 여전히 온전하고 현대적이다. 야외 장면이 아니다. Su Yi와 Su Yi Zombie는 절대 같은 프레임에 동시에 나오지 않는다.

Generation note: 아래 12개의 샷은 각각 30초짜리 두 개의 절반으로 나뉘어 있어, 각기 별도 클립으로 생성한 뒤 이어 붙일 수 있다. 각 샷에는 두 개의 타임스탬프가 적혀 있다 — "clip time" (해당 30초 생성물 안의 초)과 "full video" (최종 60초 편집본 안의 초). PART 1은 다정한 포옹에서 끝나며(감정적 정점), PART 2는 키스로 시작해 호러의 반전으로 이어진다.

PART 1 — "Before" (0:00–0:30) — PRESENT struggle → dissolve into MEMORY tenderness
Shot 1 — 0:00–0:05 (clip time) / 0:00–0:05 (full video)

Camera: PRESENT mode. 거실 안쪽에서 촬영한 핸드헬드 미디엄-와이드, Chen Hao와 함께 뒤로 물러나며 약간 옆으로 드리프트, 32mm. 흔들림은 Su Yi Zombie의 예측 불가능한 움직임에 반응한다. Foreground: 프레임 왼쪽의 뒤집힌 의자 가장자리가 흐릿하게 보임. pt.content:
THE LAST GESTURE — Prompt de Horror Zumbi/Dark Comedy de 60s (16:9)

Contexto: drama de horror zumbi fotorrealista com um payoff abrupto de dark comedy deadpan. Filmado com ARRI Alexa 35 e lentes prime esféricas. Um apartamento moderno e compacto em Pequim à noite, recentemente habitado e recém-perturbado — móveis deslocados, uma cadeira tombada, pequenos objetos espalhados, uma mesa bagunçada, cortinas fora do lugar; a arquitetura permanece intacta e contemporânea. Clima: uma casa comum que se torna hostil, onde um gesto familiar reabre por um instante algo que o cômodo já havia perdido. Grade visual: subexposição cinematográfica low-key, vazamento frio de janela em 5600K contra uma única lâmpada prática em 3000K, textura natural de pele, motion blur natural, profundidade de campo contida, grão fino sutil de filme 35mm. A grade permanece fixa em todos os planos.

O apartamento existe em dois estados de linha do tempo. Estado PRESENTE: noite, vazamento frio azul-acinzentado vindo da janela à esquerda do quadro, uma lâmpada quente fraca criando pequenos bolsões âmbar, móveis perturbados. Estado MEMÓRIA: o mesmo apartamento antes do surto — móveis restaurados, superfícies organizadas, luz doméstica prática suave e uniforme em 3000–3500K envolvendo os rostos, sem sombras de horror, pele viva e saudável. A geometria do cômodo, a posição dos móveis e o ângulo da câmera permanecem idênticos entre os dois estados; apenas a iluminação, a organização e o clima mudam.

Linguagem de câmera: o estado PRESENTE é nervoso e handheld o tempo todo — tremor visível do operador, reframing reativo, pequenas correções laterais, curtos push-pulls, leve roll durante a luta física, deriva instável da respiração. O estado MEMÓRIA é o oposto deliberado — suave, silencioso, estável, quase sem tremor. Cada plano abaixo declara qual modo usa.

Local deste vídeo: a sala de estar, com uma pequena área de jantar, kitchenette e a abertura do corredor trazendo profundidade ao fundo.

Personagens

Chen Hao (protagonista masculino) — chinês, no fim dos 20 anos, corpo magro-atlético, rosto anguloso com mandíbula forte, olhos castanho-escuros, cabelo preto curto com volume natural e uma leve franja, pele morena clara e quente, naturalmente atraente de um jeito despretensioso, “vizinho da porta ao lado”. Figurino: camiseta oversized lavada em carvão, overshirt aberta cinza-escura leve, calça jogger escura relaxada, tênis de lona escuros de cano baixo. Chen Hao é o único homem no vídeo.

Su Yi (protagonista feminina) — chinesa, meados dos 20 anos, deslumbrantemente bonita, alta e esguia com proporções e postura de modelo, cabelo longo escuro levemente ondulado com franja suave e rala, óculos finos redondos com armação metálica, olhos castanhos quentes, pele porcelana clara, traços delicados e refinados — a personificação da beleza elegante. Figurino (estado MEMÓRIA): cardigan cropped creme sobre uma blusa branca por baixo, minissaia plissada cinza-carvão, meias brancas, sapatos brancos. Su Yi existe apenas dentro do estado MEMÓRIA — limpa, saudável, ilesa.

Trava de continuidade — óculos: Su Yi usa os mesmos óculos finos redondos com armação metálica em todos os planos do vídeo, tanto no PRESENTE quanto na MEMÓRIA, sem exceções. Ela nunca aparece sem eles. No estado MEMÓRIA, os óculos estão limpos e alinhados; no estado PRESENTE/zumbi, os mesmos óculos estão sujos e tortos, mas continuam no rosto. Não remova nem omita os óculos em nenhum plano, incluindo os Planos 5 e 6.

Su Yi Zumbi — o mesmo rosto, os mesmos óculos (sujos, tortos, mas presentes), a mesma base de penteado e as mesmas proporções corporais de Su Yi. Substituição de figurino: o mesmo cardigan creme, a blusa branca e a minissaia plissada cinza-carvão agora rasgados e desgastados, pele pálida e doentia, órbitas oculares escuras e vazias, óculos sujos e tortos, cabelo bagunçado e embaraçado, manchas de sangue e sujeira no rosto, nas mãos e nas roupas.

Su Yi e Su Yi Zumbi são a mesma mulher em dois pontos no tempo — a mesma pessoa antes e depois.

Chen Hao Zumbi (revelação tardia, apenas no Plano 13) — mesmo rosto, mesmo cabelo preto curto, mesma estrutura física de Chen Hao. Figurino inalterado, mas agora rasgado no ombro/gola onde foi mordido, pele pálida e acinzentada, olhos turvos e vazios, uma mordida fresca e ensanguentada visível na base do pescoço através da overshirt rasgada, postura frouxa e rígida como a de Su Yi Zumbi.

Âncora espacial: Chen Hao começa no meio-esquerda do quadro, recuando na diagonal em direção à câmera, passando pela cadeira tombada. Su Yi Zumbi entra pelo meio-direita, vindo da direção da área de jantar. A kitchenette e a abertura do corredor permanecem visíveis em profundidade no fundo atrás de ambos. Toda a marcação acontece em um lado do cômodo — a câmera nunca cruza para a parede oposta.

Não é uma ruína pós-apocalíptica destruída — o apartamento está apenas bagunçado recentemente, ainda intacto e moderno. Não é uma cena externa. Su Yi e Su Yi Zumbi nunca aparecem no quadro ao mesmo tempo.

Nota de geração: os 12 planos abaixo estão divididos em duas metades de 30 segundos, para que cada uma possa ser gerada como um clipe separado e depois unida. Cada plano lista dois timestamps — “clip time” (segundos dentro dessa geração de 30s) e “full video” (segundos na edição final de 60s). A PARTE 1 termina no abraço terno (o ponto emocional mais alto); a PARTE 2 começa com o beijo e vira o payoff de horror.

PARTE 1 — “Antes” (0:00–0:30) — luta no PRESENTE → dissolve para ternura na MEMÓRIA
Plano 1 — 0:00–0:05 (clip time) / 0:00–0:05 (full video)

Camera: PRESENT mode. Handheld medium-wide from inside the living room, backing away with Chen Hao while drifting slightly sideways, 32mm. Shake reacts to Su Yi Zombie's unpredictable movement. Foreground: blurred edge of the overturned chair at frame-left. Midground: Chen Hao backing diagonally toward camera as Su Yi Zombie surges in from the right. Background: kitchenette and hallway mouth in low cold light. Act: Su Yi Zombie lunges at Chen Hao with uncontrolled hungry aggression — mouth open, shoulders jerking, rapid uneven steps, hands clawing forward, matted hair swinging across the crooked glasses. Chen Hao backs away fast, eyes wide, forearms raised defensively, never turning his back. Constrain: Su Yi Zombie reads as frightening from the very first frame — feral, unstable, no lingering human softness yet. Audio: uneven aggressive footsteps, furniture scraping the floor, wet snarling breath, Chen Hao's ragged breathing, clothing friction.

Plano 2 — 0:05–0:10 (clip time) / 0:05–0:10 (full video)

Camera: PRESENT mode. Handheld medium two-shot from slightly below eye level, anchored between Chen Hao at left-midground and Su Yi Zombie at right-midground, 40mm. Small backward and lateral corrections follow the struggle; slight roll when Su Yi Zombie jerks sideways. Act: Su Yi Zombie lunges again. Chen Hao catches her and grips both shoulders firmly, arms fully extended to hold the snapping mouth away from his neck. Su Yi Zombie thrashes violently — torso twisting, mouth snapping forward, head thrown side to side. Chen Hao's jaw clenches, brows pull together, breathing fast, hands tightening — visibly straining. Constrain: Chen Hao's hands stay clamped on both shoulders with arms extended for the whole shot — the mouth never reaches his neck here. Real time speed. Audio: palms slapping onto shoulders, shoe friction on the floor, strained exhales, snarling, fabric stretching.

Plano 3 — 0:10–0:14 (clip time) / 0:10–0:14 (full video)

Camera: PRESENT mode. Handheld chest-up two-shot, slow unstable micro push-in, 50mm. Shake gradually reduces but never fully disappears. Act: Su Yi Zombie's thrashing tapers into small spasms, then heavy breathing, then near stillness; the mouth slowly closes and the vacant eyes lock directly onto Chen Hao. Chen Hao stays tense and confused, hands still clamped down, not trusting the sudden calm. Constrain: the momentum drains progressively and visibly — the stillness stays uncanny and vacant,

THE LAST GESTURE — 60秒僵尸恐怖/黑色喜剧 Prompt（16:9）

Context：写实风格的僵尸恐怖剧情，结尾带有突兀、一本正经的黑色喜剧反转。使用 ARRI Alexa 35 搭配球面定焦镜头拍摄。北京一间紧凑的现代公寓，夜晚，最近有人居住过且刚被扰乱过——家具挪位、一把椅子翻倒、零散小物件散落、桌面凌乱、窗帘被拉得歪斜；建筑结构依然完整且现代。氛围：一个普通的家变得充满敌意，而一个熟悉的动作短暂地重新打开了房间早已失去的某种东西。视觉调性：低调电影感欠曝，冷色 5600K 窗光与单一 3000K 实景灯形成对比，自然皮肤质感、自然运动模糊、克制的景深、细腻的 35mm 胶片颗粒。整个片子的调色在所有镜头中保持固定。

这间公寓存在于两个时间线状态中。PRESENT 状态：夜晚，来自画面左侧窗户的冷蓝灰色漫射光，一盏昏暗暖灯制造出小块琥珀色区域，家具凌乱。MEMORY 状态：同一间公寓在爆发前——家具恢复原位，表面整洁，柔和均匀的 3000–3500K 家居实景光包裹着人物面部，没有恐怖阴影，皮肤鲜活健康。两个状态之间，房间几何、家具摆放和机位角度完全一致；只改变灯光、整洁度和氛围。

摄影语言：PRESENT 状态全程使用紧张的手持——可见的操作者抖动、反应式重构图、轻微横向修正、短促推拉、身体冲突时轻微滚转、不稳定的呼吸式漂移。MEMORY 状态则是刻意相反——平滑、安静、稳定，几乎没有抖动。下面每个镜头都会标明所使用的模式。

本片场景：客厅，带一个小餐区、简易厨房和通往走廊的入口，背景有纵深。

角色

Chen Hao（男主）——中国人，20 多岁后期，精瘦运动型身材，棱角分明、下颌线强烈的脸，深棕色眼睛，短黑发，自然蓬松，略带刘海，暖浅棕肤色，带着一种不加修饰、邻家男孩式的自然好看。服装：宽松洗旧炭灰色 T 恤、轻薄深灰色敞开式外衬衫、休闲深色慢跑裤、深色低帮帆布鞋。Chen Hao 是视频里唯一的男性。

Su Yi（女主）——中国人，20 多岁中期，惊艳美丽，身材高挑纤细，比例和姿态都像模特，长黑发略带波浪，柔软稀疏的刘海，细圆金属框眼镜，温暖的棕色眼睛，白皙瓷感皮肤，精致柔和的五官——优雅美的典范。服装（MEMORY 状态）：奶油色短款开衫，内搭白色上衣，炭灰色百褶迷你裙，白袜子，白鞋。Su Yi 只存在于 MEMORY 状态中——干净、健康、未受伤。

连续性锁定——眼镜：Su Yi 在视频的每一个镜头里都必须佩戴同一副细圆金属框眼镜，PRESENT 和 MEMORY 都一样，绝无例外。她绝不能在任何镜头中不戴眼镜。MEMORY 状态里眼镜干净且端正；PRESENT/僵尸状态里同一副眼镜脏污、歪斜，但仍然戴在脸上。不要在任何镜头中移除或省略眼镜，包括镜头 5 和 6。

Su Yi Zombie——与 Su Yi 相同的脸、相同的眼镜（脏污、歪斜，但仍在）、相同的基础发型和相同的身体比例。服装覆盖设定：同样的奶油色开衫、白色内搭和炭灰色百褶裙如今破损、磨烂，皮肤苍白且不健康，眼窝深黑空洞，眼镜脏污歪斜，头发凌乱打结，脸上、手上和衣服上有血迹与污渍。

Su Yi 和 Su Yi Zombie 是同一个女人在两个时间点上的状态——同一个人，前后变化。

Chen Hao Zombie（后段揭示，仅镜头 13）——与 Chen Hao 相同的脸、相同的短黑发、相同的体型。服装不变，但在被咬伤的肩部/领口处撕裂，皮肤变得苍白灰败，眼睛浑浊空洞，透过撕开的外衬衫可见颈根处新鲜带血的咬伤，姿态像 Su Yi Zombie 一样松垮僵硬。

空间锚点：Chen Hao 从中景左侧开始，沿对角线向镜头后退，经过翻倒的椅子。Su Yi Zombie 从中景右侧、餐区方向进入。简易厨房和走廊入口始终在两人身后的远景中可见。所有调度都保持在房间同一侧——镜头绝不跨到对面墙。

不是被摧毁的末日废墟——公寓只是最近比较凌乱，仍然完整且现代。不是户外场景。Su Yi 和 Su Yi Zombie 绝不会同时出现在同一画面里。

生成说明：下面 12 个镜头被拆分成两个 30 秒半段，便于分别生成后再拼接。每个镜头都列出两个时间戳——“clip time”（该 30 秒生成片段内的秒数）和“full video”（最终 60 秒成片中的秒数）。PART 1 以温柔拥抱结束（情绪高点）；PART 2 以亲吻开场，并转入恐怖反转。

PART 1 — “Before”（0:00–0:30）— PRESENT 争斗 → 融入 MEMORY 的温柔
Shot 1 — 0:00–0:05 (clip time) / 0:00–0:05 (full video)

Camera: PRESENT mode. 手持中远景，从客厅内部拍摄，跟着 Chen Hao 后退，同时轻微横向漂移，32mm。抖动会对 Su Yi Zombie 不可预测的动作做出反应。前景：画面左侧翻倒椅子的虚化边缘。中景：Chen Hao 一边向镜头方向斜向后退，一边被 Su Yi Zombie 从右侧逼近。背景：简易厨房和走廊入口处于低冷光中。Act: Su Yi Zombie 以失控、饥饿的攻击性扑向 Chen Hao——张口、肩膀抽动、快速不稳的步伐、双手前抓，打结的头发在歪斜的眼镜前甩动。Chen Hao 快速后退，眼睛睁大，双臂防御性抬起，始终不把后背转过去。Constrain: Su Yi Zombie 从第一帧起就必须显得可怕——野性、不稳定，还没有任何残留的人性柔软。Audio: 不均匀的凶狠脚步、家具摩擦地板、湿重的低吼呼吸、Chen Hao 急促凌乱的喘息、衣料摩擦声。

Shot 2 — 0:05–0:10 (clip time) / 0:05–0:10 (full video)

Camera: PRESENT mode. 手持中景双人镜头，机位略低于视线高度，构图锚定在左中景的 Chen Hao 与右中景的 Su Yi Zombie 之间，40mm。随着冲突进行，镜头做小幅后退和横向修正；当 Su Yi Zombie 猛地侧甩时，画面轻微滚转。Act: Su Yi Zombie 再次扑上来。Chen Hao 接住她，双手牢牢抓住她的双肩，手臂完全伸直，把咬合的嘴从自己脖子旁顶开。Su Yi Zombie 剧烈
